verses.1: For the leader. A psalm of David. A song.
verses.2: To you we owe our hymn of praise, O God on Zion; To you our vows must be fulfilled,
verses.3: you who hear our prayers. To you all flesh must come
verses.4: with its burden of wicked deeds. We are overcome by our sins; only you can pardon them.
verses.5: Happy the chosen ones you bring to dwell in your courts. May we be filled with the good things of your house, the blessings of your holy temple!
verses.6: You answer us with awesome deeds of justice, O God our savior, The hope of all the ends of the earth and of far distant islands.
verses.7: You are robed in power, you set up the mountains by your might.
verses.8: You still the roaring of the seas, the roaring of their waves, the tumult of the peoples.
verses.9: Distant peoples stand in awe of your marvels; east and west you make resound with joy.
verses.10: You visit the earth and water it, make it abundantly fertile. God's stream is filled with water; with it you supply the world with grain. Thus do you prepare the earth:
verses.11: you drench plowed furrows, and level their ridges. With showers you keep the ground soft, blessing its young sprouts.
verses.12: You adorn the year with your bounty; your paths drip with fruitful rain.
verses.13: The untilled meadows also drip; the hills are robed with joy.
verses.14: The pastures are clothed with flocks, the valleys blanketed with grain; they cheer and sing for joy.

notes.text: Vows: the Israelites were accustomed to promising sacrifices in the temple if their prayers were heard.
To you all flesh must come: all must have recourse to God's mercy.
Awesome deeds: the acts of creating - installing mountains, taming seas, restraining nations (Psalm 65:7-8) - that are visible worldwide (Psalm 65:6, 9).
Apparently a description of the agricultural year, beginning with the first fall rains that soften the hard sun-baked soil (Psalm 65:9-10).
God's stream: the fertile waters of the earth derive from God's fertile waters in the heavenly world.
Paths: probably the tracks of God's storm chariot dropping rain upon earth.
